fields.summary_ko.0: Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) stock down 13% over past year despite 86% revenue surge, with Q3 stock price $326.08 maintaining 15-year consecutive dividend per share increase of $0.65.
fields.summary_ko.1: AI semiconductor revenue guided from Q3 $16.70B (221% year-over-year increase) to Q4 approximately $21.7B (236% year-over-year increase).
fields.summary_ko.2: Customer demand exceeds Broadcom's supply capacity, with company beginning substrate production at Singapore fab and increasing Q4 capital expenditures to $1.4B.
